note: PPC FY 25: inter- and intra-state transmission charges, the SLDC fee and reactive power (rows 61–64) — the ARR's transmission line (row 23).  These rows print only their billed amount (P, typed: the bill), so it is given; net of rebate (R) and with transmission (V) are computed.

blank_is_zero.why: NPCL leaves a charge blank where a source has none; its totals (P = SUM(M:O), R = P − Q, U = S + T, V = U + R) read the blanks as zero
